Given this, I believe the test file itself has an error (check(2) should not be included, since 2 is not a perfect square, or sqrt_int is meant to only be called on perfect squares and check(2) is a leftover/incorrect test case). Since I'm instructed not to change the test file, I can't resolve this by removing/fixing that line myself.
